name: Deathknell
summary: Deathknell is where the newly freed dead first wake, in a hidden valley of southwestern Tirisfal. They have broken from the Lich King's grasp, and here they join the Forsaken. But mindless Scourge, zealots and wild beasts beset the village. For anyone who would claim a place in Sylvanas Windrunner's kingdom, it is a harsh first trial.

sections.title: Cradle of the Forsaken
sections.body:
The valley lies behind jagged hills, just north of the Silverpine border. Elite Deathguards keep the narrow gorge out of the valley sealed. Most towns in Tirisfal kept their human names from fallen Lordaeron. This one did not. The undead who claimed it named it Deathknell.

The town itself is split in two. Its northern half is still overrun by mindless zombies and feral ghouls, the village forge with it. The Forsaken cling to the southern grounds, around the old church. There the caretakers take in each new arrival, and bring them into the Banshee Queen's service.

sections.title: A Valley Under Siege
sections.body: Survival here is never certain. To the northwest, monstrous spiders have taken Night Web's Hollow, a gold mine the young Forsaken nation needs. To the southeast, the Scarlet Crusade keeps a camp, and watches the valley without rest. Its couriers run to the Crusade's strongholds in the east, and its scouts probe Deathknell's defenses. And in the northern ruins, the caretakers must still fight off the mindless dead.

faq.q: Why was the town renamed Deathknell?
faq.answer: The undead who claimed Deathknell renamed it after making it their settlement, unlike most Tirisfal communities, which kept their human names. Why they chose that name is unknown.

faq.q: Why is the northern half of the town overrun by undead?
faq.answer: Many corpses raised after the Third War did not regain their minds. The northern village square and forge are infested with the Mindless Ones, feral zombies, ghouls, and skeletons still driven by the Scourge’s lingering will. Forsaken defenders clear them out to salvage equipment and guard the church. Caretakers gather scrap metal, tools, and supplies for newly arisen souls setting out on the road ahead.

faq.q: What is the Scarlet Crusade doing near Deathknell?
faq.answer: A Scarlet Crusade detachment camps in the hills southeast of Deathknell. Its members seek to destroy all undead, watch the pass, ambush newly awakened Forsaken, and exchange scouting intelligence with Scarlet strongholds elsewhere in Lordaeron.

faq.q: Why can't the Forsaken use the local gold mine?
faq.answer: Night Web’s Hollow, in the cliffs northwest of Deathknell, is overrun by aggressive spiders. Gold matters to the Forsaken war effort, but the settlement cannot exploit the vein while the spiders remain. Its loss cuts off a resource vital to the Forsaken’s fledgling economy.

angles.text: As a Forsaken adventurer, you begin here, rising from the cold earth of the Shadow Grave. Lady Sylvanas offers purpose and shelter after the horror of the Plague.
Though this valley is isolated and dark, it opens onto the Forsaken kingdom and sends fresh soldiers to strengthen the Horde’s foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms.
